svg.title: Real kx selects a root on the quadrant-I boundary

cc:Work.dc:title: Real kx selects a root on the quadrant-I boundary
cc:Work.dc:description: Increasing kx from 0 to 2 in air moves the selected root from 1 to 0 along the real axis (propagating), then upward along the imaginary axis (evanescent): the boundary of quadrant I. The discarded root −kz lies opposite.
